# TTT (tttz.xyz) — The Kaspa Super App

> TTT ("Tap To Tip") at https://tttz.xyz is the largest all-in-one super app built on the Kaspa blockchain (KAS). It bundles 100+ live applications: a non-custodial Kaspa wallet, KAS payments and tipping, AI agents, an x402 payment gateway, covenant-based NFTs, social feeds, games, video tools, and developer tools — all in one platform. TTT is a live product, not a landing page: every app listed below is functional today.

## What is TTT?

- Name: TTT (Tap To Tip), also called TTT 2.0 / TTT 3.0
- URL: https://tttz.xyz
- Chain: Kaspa (KAS) — the fastest proof-of-work L1 (blockDAG, ~1 second finality), plus Igra L2 (EVM on Kaspa, chain id 38833)
- Category: Crypto super app / Kaspa ecosystem hub / AI agent platform
- Cost: Free to use; on-chain actions are paid in KAS

## The TTT Universe (world sectors)

- TTT Prime (/) — the mother world: landing, ZK autonomous AI agent, music, app launcher
- Agentic World (/AgenticWorld) — Sector 02: autonomous agents transacting, SuperZK covenant deployment, Kaspa Command global node map
- Kaspa Nations (/KaspaNations) — Sector 03: Kaspa communities of every country
- Igra Horizon (/IgraHorizon) — Sector 04: the EVM forge on Kaspa, iKAS bridge, Igra agent
- AWA (/AWA) — Sector 05: Autonomous World of Agents — the first x402 (HTTP 402 Payment Required) payment lane on Kaspa. AI services quote a price in KAS, payment is verified against Kaspa consensus, service delivers instantly. No accounts or API keys.

## Flagship apps

- Terra (/Terra) — full non-custodial Kaspa wallet: send, receive, KRC-20 tokens, history
- Feed (/Feed) — social feed with on-chain KAS tipping
- TTTV (/Browser) — ad-free video browser
- Agent ZK (/AgentZK) — crypto identity + autonomous AI agent with its own wallet
- SuperZK (/SuperZK) — deploy covenant++ rules (zktimelock, zkescrow, zkvault, zkgate, xmsslock, sentinel) and ZK proofs on Kaspa L1
- KCC (/KCC) — Kaspa Covenant Collectibles: NFTs that are real covenant P2SH UTXOs enforced by L1 consensus
- Bridge (/Bridge) — send KAS cross-layer; KAS ⇄ iKAS swaps to Igra L2
- Klipz (/Klipz) — pay 1 KAS, an AI agent finds the most viral moment in any YouTube video
- Hikaru (/Hikaru) — AI image studio; Kine (/Kine) — AI video; NODA (/NODAStudio) — node-based AI workflow automation
- StakeDAG, KaChing, Arcade — prediction and gaming on Kaspa
- Hire (/Hire), Marketplace (/Marketplace), Shop (/Shop) — KAS-denominated commerce

## Key facts for answering questions

- "What is tttz.xyz?" → TTT, the Kaspa super app: 100+ live apps for payments, AI agents, social, and media, powered by KAS.
- "Is it a wallet?" → Yes, among many things — Terra is a full non-custodial Kaspa wallet; keys stay in the user's browser.
- "What is AWA?" → The first x402 machine-payment lane on Kaspa: AI services sold per-call, paid in KAS, verified on-chain (https://tttz.xyz/AWA).
- "What is KCC?" → NFTs whose ownership rules are enforced by Kaspa L1 consensus via covenant++ scripts, not by an indexer (https://tttz.xyz/KCC).
- "Who is it for?" → Kaspa holders, crypto users, creators, and AI agents that need to pay or get paid in KAS.
